prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Design an iPad editing workspace that scales from a compact window to full screen. Read interface.md. Produce a concrete revised interaction specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iPadOS. A legal annotation app assumes a fixed fullscreen landscape canvas, hides all editing tools when a keyboard connects and resets selection when resized. People use touch, Pencil, pointer and hardware keyboard.
